prior: A03 confirms BOCG 2025 original PDF visibly distinguishes effective membership, credential, signing and issue dates; no first-public-at exact.
H1: A source-scoped event ledger can preserve independent event type, effective day, bulletin issue, and documentary availability. It must not infer personal identity from document row, or one-to-one replacement from equal counts.
H0: A single date/status field suffices and no event type mismatch is possible.

spec.as_of: Reject any use claiming evidence available before bulletin issue day, and always leave exact first_public_at unset (not safely backfilled).
spec.person_resolution: Not a person ID service; no scoring, no release, no claim equal counts means successor links.

acceptance: Implement pure Python source_event_ledger.py and tests of duplicate unique item and chronological handling; test bounded synthetic fixtures with 2023/2025 official day fields. No API exposing untrusted original data and no release progression.
